commercial_product.note: Core revenue is medical devices, not drugs. Marketed device franchises include da Vinci surgical robotic systems (multi-port: Si, X, Xi, da Vinci 5; single-port: SP), Ion endoluminal robotic bronchoscopy system, instruments and accessories (EndoWrist, staplers, energy), and digital/services (My Intuitive, Intuitive Hub). FDA-cleared via 510(k) pathway (e.g., K242318, K232610, K230033, K183086).
